newsitem.title: USA: International Alliance buys cos for $12 mln.
newsitem.headline: International Alliance buys cos for $12 mln.

text.p: International Alliance Services Inc said Monday it agreed to acquire Health Administration Services Inc of Houston, Texas for $2.8 million cash and $4.2 payable in its restricted common stock.
It also agreed to merge with Business Management Services Inc of Roanoke, Virginia for $5 million in common stock.
The merger will be accounted for as a pooling of interest.
BMS is a payroll administration and benefits outsourcing firm. HAS is a healthcare management services company.
The company said the acquisitions, which it expects to close by the end of July, will add more than $11 million to its annualized revenue.

In addition, the company said it completed the previously announced acquisition of St. James General Agency of Conroe, Texas. The company could not immediately provide information on the purchase price of that acquisition.

In May, the company announced it had entered agreements to acquire several companies, including St. James, at a combined acquisition cost of 1,038,572 shares of its restricted common stock, $4.44 million in cash and a two-year $237,000 note.
